current_proposals.title: Unified Employee Mobile Platform
current_proposals.business_problem: Employees want faster access to attendance, leave management, and important company notifications while using mobile devices.
current_proposals.proposal: Build a unified mobile platform that provides employee attendance, leave management, notifications, employee information, and other frequently used HR services.
objectives: Improve employee access to HR services
Provide faster access to attendance and leave features
Deliver important notifications through mobile devices

current_context.existing_solution: Web-based employee portal and Progressive Web Application

alternatives_considered: Continue improving the existing web portal
Extend the existing Progressive Web Application
Build a dedicated native mobile platform
current_proposals.expected_outcome: Increase employee engagement with digital HR services and provide a more convenient mobile experience.

current_proposals.title: Microservices Architecture for New Product
current_proposals.business_problem: NovaTech is developing a new product that is expected to experience significant growth and requires independent scaling and deployment of different application components.
current_proposals.proposal: Design the new product using independently deployable microservices instead of building another monolithic backend.
objectives: Prepare the platform for future growth
alternatives_considered: Build the new product using microservices
current_proposals.expected_outcome: Create a scalable architecture that allows independent development, deployment, and scaling of major product components.

current_proposals.title: Regional Customer Data Center Expansion
current_proposals.business_problem: NovaTech needs additional infrastructure capacity to support customers in a new geographic region and reduce latency for those customers.
current_proposals.proposal: Deploy additional production infrastructure in a new geographic region to improve application latency and regional availability.
alternatives_considered: Deploy infrastructure in the new geographic region
current_proposals.expected_outcome: Improve application performance and availability for customers in the new region.

current_proposals.title: Tiered Subscription Pricing
current_proposals.business_problem: NovaTech wants to make recurring revenue more predictable while providing pricing options that better match differences in customer usage.
current_proposals.proposal: Introduce tiered subscription plans with different prices and feature limits for small, medium, and enterprise customers.
objectives: Provide pricing options for different customer segments
Reduce customer dissatisfaction caused by a single pricing structure
alternatives_considered: Create separate pricing models for each customer segment
current_proposals.expected_outcome: Improve revenue predictability while providing pricing options that better match different customer usage patterns.

current_proposals.title: Employee Mobile Feature Expansion
current_proposals.business_problem: NovaTech wants to improve employee access to frequently used HR services on mobile devices.
current_proposals.proposal: Develop three separate mobile initiatives: mobile attendance, mobile leave management, and mobile notifications.

current_context.existing_solution: Employee web portal and Progressive Web Application

components.title: Mobile Attendance
components.description: Allow employees to view and manage attendance information through a mobile interface.

components.title: Mobile Leave Management
components.description: Allow employees to submit and track leave requests through a mobile interface.

components.title: Mobile Notifications
components.description: Provide employees with important company and HR notifications through a mobile interface.

alternatives_considered: Continue improving the existing employee web platform
Extend the existing Progressive Web Application
Develop the three mobile capabilities separately
current_proposals.expected_outcome: Improve employee access to frequently used HR services through mobile interfaces.
